_about: Fallback declarations for rows whose instrument files carry no in-file header (INDEX-SPEC.md). Keyed by <repo>/<path>. A header in the file WINS over an entry here and a disagreement is reported as DRIFT by build_index.py. Every entry carries a `basis` line saying who entered it and from what; every run_cost is `author-estimate` unless stated otherwise. Rows absent from this file and from any header read UNRATED and are listed anyway.
_basis_default: input_shape, catches and status entered by the schema-author session (AI) from the folder's own README / CLAIM_TABLE and the Simulators CLAUDE.md index entry, NOT by running the instrument. gate=PASSED is entered ONLY where the folder registers a metric in Simulators/tools/known_answer.py and that metric's cases pass; gate=FAILED where the registered metric is pinned failing; UNRUN otherwise. test_index.py cross-checks every PASSED/FAILED gate against that registry.
_shape_note: input_shape is the shape of what the reader is HOLDING when the instrument applies, not the topic. Multi-valued rows name the primary shape first.
